from itertools import permutations

CARGO = ["fuel", "grain", "livestock", "machinery", "produce", "textiles"]
OPTIONS = {"A": 2, "B": 3, "C": 4, "D": 5, "E": 6}
SUBMITTED_VALUE = 3  # submitted final answer: "three" (option B)

solutions = []
# perm[i] is the cargo in bay i+1. Exhaustive over all 6! = 720 assignments.
for perm in permutations(CARGO):
    pos = {c: i + 1 for i, c in enumerate(perm)}
    G, L, T = pos["grain"], pos["livestock"], pos["textiles"]
    P, F, M = pos["produce"], pos["fuel"], pos["machinery"]

    if not (G > L > T):          # grain > livestock > textiles
        continue
    if not (P > F):              # produce > fuel
        continue
    if abs(T - P) != 1:          # textiles next to produce
        continue
    if abs(M - G) != 2:          # exactly one bay between machinery and grain
        continue
    solutions.append(perm)

print("Valid arrangements found:", len(solutions))
for s in solutions:
    print("  bays 1..6:", list(s))

determined_bays = []
for i in range(6):
    values = {s[i] for s in solutions}
    if len(values) == 1:
        determined_bays.append((i + 1, values.pop()))

print("Determined bays:")
for bay, cargo_idx in determined_bays:
    print(f"  bay {bay}: {CARGO[cargo_idx]}")

computed_count = len(determined_bays)
print("Computed count of determined bays:", computed_count)

matching = [k for k, v in OPTIONS.items() if v == computed_count]
print("Computed option:", matching[0] if matching else "none")
print("Submitted value:", SUBMITTED_VALUE)

if solutions and computed_count == SUBMITTED_VALUE:
    print("CHECK PASS")
elif solutions:
    print("CHECK FAIL")
else:
    print("CHECK UNKNOWN")
